key_idea: Start at the square pearl and go around the band to the right, checking each color.
steps: In the row, after the square the pearls are pink, turquoise, yellow, pink, green, blue.
On each band, start at the square at the top and go around to the right.
Band C goes pink, turquoise, yellow, pink, green, blue. That is the same order as the row.

choice_feedback.A: After yellow comes green and then pink. In the row, pink comes before green.
choice_feedback.B: Right after the square comes pink, then blue. In the row, turquoise comes after pink.
choice_feedback.D: The first two pearls are turquoise, then pink. In the row, pink comes first.
choice_feedback.E: After turquoise comes pink, then yellow. In the row, yellow comes before pink.
